shared_elements: reins and pole/yoke lines running from horse to chariot
bridled horse head with harness ornament
spoked wheel shown as full circle with radiating spokes
justification: Both depict the same distinctive scheme: a bridled horse in left-facing profile drawing a chariot at right, with long straight reins/pole lines crossing the field to a standing figure in the chariot box, and a multi-spoked wheel rendered as a full circle at the lower right — the same relative placement and same low-relief profile convention. Differences are in supporting content only: A adds a standing attendant at the far left and a fallen/trampled body beneath the horse, while B adds a decorative rosette border band along the bottom and shows no subsidiary figures.
